project.name: Monikie
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: All 17 HES/NRHE/statutory records retained; eight dated pins visible, one dated duplicate NRHE castle record hidden behind the statutory castle record, and eight undated records hidden. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Selector only
touristAppeal.summary: Monikie village has a useful coffee-and-cake stop and local historic records, while Monikie Country Park is an excellent separate attraction with trails and facilities. The settlement itself remains small and does not inherit the park’s destination score.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: The Country Park welcomes controlled dogs except in the play park; the village café policy is separately assessed.

visitorHighlights.name: Monikie Country Park
visitorHighlights.reason: A substantial, well-supported family and outdoor destination with diverse activities and practical facilities; paid activities and seasonal café hours need planning.
visitorHighlights.admission: Free park entry; activities priced separately

editorialReview.scoreRationale: A substantial, well-supported family and outdoor destination with diverse activities and practical facilities; paid activities and seasonal café hours need planning.

townGuide.characterTag: Small village beside a reservoir country park
townGuide.headline: A modest village with a major nearby park
townGuide.intro: Monikie scores 48% and remains selector-only. Treat the Country Park as the main See attraction, with Victoria Sponge as the village coffee-and-cake stop.
perfectFor: A park visit rather than a town-centre day
townGuide.visitorMood: Quiet village edges and an active family country park.
